related.title: Google Willow 表面碼系統
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制；Google Willow 表面碼系統改以碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control; Google Willow surface-code system centers on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照transmon 能階與Willow 非諧能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google Willow 表面碼系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以邏輯錯誤證據為起點，設計一項能區分「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」與「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare transmon levels with willow anharmonic levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google Willow surface-code system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from logical-error evidence and propose an observation distinguishing tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control from code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, including uncertainty.

related.title: Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制；Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構改以方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control; Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture centers on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照transmon 能階與Ankaa 接面與能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以邏輯錯誤證據為起點，設計一項能區分「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」與「方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare transmon levels with ankaa junctions and levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from logical-error evidence and propose an observation distinguishing tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control from square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation, including uncertainty.

history.title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
history.text: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器的公開資料展示可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor illustrate tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
